import pandas as pd, numpy as np, sys
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, box
a=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1],index_col=0); b=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[2],index_col=0)
assert list(a.columns)==list(b.columns) and len(a)==len(b)
for c in ['raw_classification','main_classification','super_classification','type']: assert (a[c]==b[c]).all()
P=[]
for i,r in b.iterrows():
    xs=list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))); ys=list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(',')))
    p=Polygon(zip(xs,ys)); P.append(p)
    assert p.is_valid, i
    assert not p.equals(box(*p.bounds)), ('rect',i)
    assert (min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys))==(r.xmin,r.xmax,r.ymin,r.ymax)
ov=sum(1 for i in range(len(P)) for j in range(i+1,len(P)) if P[i].intersects(P[j]))
print('intersecting pairs',ov)
for t in ['rectangle','polyline']:
    ious=[]
    for i,r in a.iterrows():
        if r.type!=t: continue
        q=Polygon(zip(map(int,r.coords_x.split(',')),map(int,r.coords_y.split(','))))
        ious.append(P[i].intersection(q).area/P[i].union(q).area)
    print(t,'mean IoU vs original',np.mean(ious).round(3),'min',np.min(ious).round(3))
print('areas',np.percentile([p.area for p in P],[0,50,100]))
EOF
